fixes.find: The largest US food aid programme, Food for Peace, requires that the food it sends be grown in the United States, so even emergency help to a country like Haiti is bought from American farmers and shipped.

fixes.why: Food for Peace is not the largest US food aid programme: CRS reports $2.94 billion programmed for the Emergency Food Security Program in FY2024, which is larger (https://www.everycrsreport.com/files/2026-01-26_IF13162_a9350f2d453aa8c761ca1f98033ac5bda268637b.html). The 100% US-grown rule is confirmed by PBS NewsHour. 'A country like Haiti' goes back to the opening example in paragraph 3 (structure rule).
